Found by #25 during the referee rerun (2026-11-09). store.ts `quoteFound`, the check that a Quote is verbatim from the Source's stored text, doesn't treat curly quotes and straight quotes as the same character. A referee reply quoting `"I wish to be of the opposite sex"` was refused because the stored text has `“…”`. It passed on a retry, but this will keep refusing good replies now and then, and each refusal costs a retry call.

- Reproduce it as a failing test first. Then fold typographic look-alikes into one character inside the comparison only: “ ” „ ″ to ", ‘ ’ ‚ ′ to '.
- The stored text and the Quote as shown stay byte-for-byte as they are. Only the check gets looser.
- Check that the extract, referee and Check-harder paths all go through the same check.

Two bugs from Cara (2026-11-11) in the release Android app, mandate-1.apk (versionCode 1). Her words: "back in the app shouldnt go to citadel, clicking on the today widget should always open the today view".

1. **Back goes to Citadel.** The system Back gesture or button in the app should stay inside Mandate: it closes an open sheet first, steps back through Mandate's own views, leaves the app at Mandate's root, and never lands on a Citadel page. A first look (unverified): MainActivity.java has no back handling of its own, so the WebView walks its history back into Citadel's pages. Prove the cause first.
2. **The widget tap doesn't always open Today**, from a cold start, from the background, and while Mandate is open on another view. MainActivity.onNewIntent opens a tap in place when Mandate is already showing, so the old view stays.

Both fixes are probably native, so this makes the next release, mandate-2.apk.

Bug found by #106, which Cara picked on 2026-11-11.

The bug: a `what_if` change that equips an overlay unique, or allocates a node an overlay rewrote, reports only the base run's facts. The worker's whatIf returns no overlay facts for its overrides (`app/pob/pob-worker.lua`). So the change's speculative basis goes missing, both from what the build agent sees and from the build's summary of facts below `live`. This was already true on main before #106.

Make whatIf return the overlay facts its overrides rest on, in the same shape the base run uses. Ship with `tools/land.sh` after self-review.

Design Ctrl-Z undo (and redo) for build changes in Theory of Crafting. This covers changes a person makes in the build view and changes the build agent makes through its tools.

Josh asked on 2026-11-12: "Could we support Ctrl-Z to undo build changes? How would that work with changes made by agents?" He picked "Start a design minion". This minion designs only: no code lands until a member approves your plan.

What exists today: a variant row holds only its current PoB `xml` and an integer `revision`; every edit bumps the revision; writes pass `base_revision`. The starting shape I gave Josh (challenge any of it): store every revision's XML with who made it; an undo writes the older XML as a new revision; an agent's whole turn undoes as one step; Ctrl-Z undoes the newest change whoever made it.

One-off code health run for The Trans Agenda. Cara picked it on 2026-11-15: each scheme owns the audits of its own code, and this scheme gets "code health" now.

Code health covers what the changes on main left messier than they found it. Scope: `git log --since='30 days ago' main` and the 10 files those commits touched most. Not the whole repo.

Look for dead code, duplication (the same helper written twice by minions working in parallel), the `shortcut:` ledger's total, tests that prove nothing, and files past about 1,500 lines. Worth reporting means a bug, or a fix a minion could make in under a day. Write reports/code-health-<date>.md, ranked, with file:line, why it matters and size S/M for each finding.

Start from the handoff `handoffs/handoff-skills-stocktake.md`. Background is in `reports/skills-survey-2026-11.md` in the same shared folder.

Josh, 2026-11-06, on the survey's plan card: "Let's start each minion and see how things go and what they find and how we can best integrate them".

This is a process-only change, so it ships when green: run the tests, self-review it, then land it with tools/land.sh. Other skills minions edit `kit/skills/` at the same time.

Josh's 2026-11-19 PoE 2 "Rend missing" session showed the aura agent's tools letting it hurt itself. Fix these in companion/src (agent-tools.ts and friends) and companion/prompts:

1. pc_install put broken files on the player's PC: a `{}` placeholder glyph file once, then a cut-down aura file; each answered "ok". Make pc_install send only the saved version of a file.

3. Argument slips that each cost a round (view_video given `count` without from_ms/to_ms, run_harness given a clip's capture id).

A failing test for each before its fix. Known shape; keep each fix small.
